Introduction
Ayurveda is one of the world’s oldest holistic systems. Originating in India and widely practised in Sri Lanka, Ayurveda emphasises balance between the body, mind and spirit. The word “Ayurveda” comes from the Sanskrit words “Ayur” (life) and “Veda” (knowledge or science), meaning the “Science of Life”.

Core principles
Ayurveda describes five elements: Earth (Prithvi), Water (Jala), Fire (Teja), Air (Vayu) and Space (Akasha). In this tradition they combine to form three doshas: Vata, Pitta and Kapha. A person’s own combination of doshas is called their Prakriti.
